skillFull: A shining light appears at given intervals, and Jewel Egg Jellies are created. The Jewel Egg Jellies fly forward. Level Up for more points for Jewel Egg Jellies.
story: While resting on a branch, Crowberry Cookie discovered a tiny egg, fast asleep. The Cookie decided to turn the egg into a brooch so beautiful, it seemed the very stars of the night sky had been embroidered onto it. Seeing as the Cookie decorated the brooch with precious feathers, it is clear this is among the Cookie's most precious treasures of the Raven Tower.

costumes.name: Call of the Black Swan
costumes.info: Eggsquisite Brooch wrapped itself in silky, black feathers. While as elegant as a ballet performance, this Pet silently waits... but for what? Could the legends, speaking of the Black Swan singing just before it awakens, be true?

costumes.name: Cradle of the stars
costumes.info: Eggsquisite Brooch knows the stories of countless stars born and disappearing in the dark night sky. With pristine feathers adorned with golden embellishments, the Pet peacefully slumbers. What dreams could be unfolding in its silent slumber?
